description: This Java interface 'StatusSupplier' in the package 'org.eclipse.ditto.services.utils.health.status' defines a contract for supplying a CompletionStage that yields a JsonObject representing a status. It is intended for asynchronously providing status information, with a note indicating that for health status, a different interface 'StatusHealthSupplier' should be used.

classes.name: StatusSupplier
classes.description: A Java interface extending Supplier to asynchronously supply a JsonObject indicating status information.

methods.name: <default method from Supplier interface>
methods.description: The 'get' method inherited from java.util.function.Supplier, expected to return a CompletionStage<JsonObject> representing the status.
